snippet.title: Copper Odyssey 2 DEMO - Developer Playthrough - All Blessings
snippet.description:
https://cam999.itch.io/co2-demo
The demo for CO2 is out! This demo is a standalone story, separate from the main story of the upcoming Copper Odyssey 2. 

This video aims to act as a guide or just a viewing of the demo, minus a few interactions with Boxer and Lottle. This video is good if you are also having trouble finding the 3 blessings! Enjoy.
